name: Role classification
description: How an office is filled. Kept small and based on the mechanism rather than the title, because job titles don't translate across countries, but how someone gets the job does.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Appointed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filled by another officeholder or body's decision.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Employed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filled through a hiring process — a staff job, not a government office.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Ex officio
hasDefinedTerm.description: Comes automatically with another office. Whoever holds that other Post holds this one too.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Volunteer
hasDefinedTerm.description: Unpaid, usually on an advisory board or commission.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Hereditary
hasDefinedTerm.description: Passed down through inheritance. Rare, but real in some countries, so those systems don't have to misreport it as 'appointed'.
